resource_policy.computation_policy: Mathematica or Python may check finite anchor, jump, residue-band, endpoint, and operator identities only. Every computation is diagnostic_only and cannot certify an asymptotic estimate.

frozen_target.question: Can the exact Round-189 projectively fast one-outer-real-part complement be proved through cancellation in the joint literal signed height-jump coboundary packet, can a strict target-safe jump sector with an exact complement be proved, or can the first exact literal jump-correlation obstruction be isolated?
frozen_target.reference_formula: Fix Q=H_B=floor((log(2X))^B), a nonempty Y<h<=2Y block with Y>Q, U=mq>4Q, q>Q, m|a|_q>Q, Qm<Y, and j_q(a,v)=|a inverse(v mod q)|_q>T_Q=min((q-1)/2,floor(Qmq/Y)). For a nonempty dyadic J-band, z_(omega,v)=e(epsilon_omega a inverse(v mod q)/q), Delta^-W_v(h)=W_v(h)-W_v(h-1), and J_packet=sum_(omega,v in band)(1-z_(omega,v))^(-1) sum_h Delta^-W_v(h)z_(omega,v)^h. Prove |J_packet|<<_(B,epsilon) Q m kappa u X^epsilon uniformly, or an exactly ledger-equivalent estimate, while retaining every literal field in one signed aggregate.
quantities: The carrier and amplitudes are exactly K185.27 and K185.30--K185.35 after the accepted Round-187 Fourier, Round-188 lift, and Round-189 projective reductions.
For fixed kappa,u,m,q,a, the relation U=mq divides u, g=u/U, (u,v)=1, (U,h)=1, 0<2kappa g h<ceil(L), Y<h<=2Y, and both orientations remains literal.

W_v(h) is the complete zero-extended actual height sequence, including the dyadic block, carrier, affine t-sum, selector, squarefree and coprimality masks, profile, floor, star, half-weight, hard sample, crossings, endpoints, Fejer factor, square-root phase, sign, and terminal zero extension.
The Abel identity is endpoint-exact but supplies no cancellation by itself. Common-range differences and all births and deaths must remain in the same signed packet.
On J<=j_q(a,v)<2J, |1-z|^(-1) is comparable to q/J. Positive total variation would need scale Q m kappa u J/q, while the available scale is Y kappa u J/q. The exact deficit is Y/(Qm), primitive Y/Q.
No absolute value may be moved inside the complete jump packet and the two orientations may not be separately absolutized.
A claimed orientation involution, projective-neighbor difference, periodic mask, smooth free weight, or source theorem must be proved at the literal interface rather than assumed.

Even complete success closes at most the exact original-t=1 residual after accepted connectors. Every original t>=2 small-G incidence, the large-G near-resonant complement, the hard parent, smooth M1, M2, endpoint, bridges, and the global theorem remain separate.

Prove the full fast packet, prove a nonempty strict target-safe packet with an exact one-outer-real-part complement, or give a rigorous scoped no-go identifying the first failed correlation and exact remaining deficit.
Receive a statement-only independent rederivation of the jump identity, operator capacity, literal hypotheses, and strongest justified conclusion.
Use finite Mathematica or Python checks only to test exact identities, degeneracies, adversarial arrays, and proposed involutions; archive parameters, outputs, and limitations.

Review normalization and endpoints, jump-source coverage, signed and absolute-value placement, power and divisor ledgers, blind post-unmask consistency, and downstream owner scope before any promotion.

Apply no graph change without a mechanically valid State Patch, independent reverse/replay audit, green lifecycle validation, and exactly one declared terminal label. Do not pivot in-round to another owner or exponent.
